source: USPTO, "Federal trademark searching: Field tag searching" handout
rules: Field tags are upper case and end with a colon; search terms are lower case.
Wildcards: ? is exactly one character and * is any number of characters, anywhere in a term and in any field, never inside quotation marks.
Operators: AND, OR (or a space inside parentheses), AND NOT, and parentheses for grouping.
Combined line searches (1 AND 2) need expert mode; this recipe generates single-line queries only.

tags.meaning: Combined mark: word mark, pseudo mark, translation and transliteration
Live or dead: LD:true or LD:false
International class, three digits; grouped as IC:(009 042 045 a b 200)
Filing date range, e.g. FD:[20230701 TO *]
